items.title: "Wild" Bill Davison Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Uh, but you ran into Pops frequently then? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and Pops looks exactly today as he looked then He never ages one day

ctx.x: Our, uh, tape open, you were telling me about having seen Pops Foster

Oh, well you see the, uh, Faith Marable band Is that the way you say it? Faith Marable band Used to, uh, pull in Cincinnati And at that time We were on the Island Queen The, uh, uh, Chubb Steinberg band was on the Island Queen And the idea was Each night we would, uh, sort of late afternoon We'd play up to Coney Island There's an amusement park there in Cincinnati called Coney Island And we'd play on the Island Queen Until we got to the island And then we'd play all evening And then play back And so Pops Foster…
Do you remember anybody that had said Pops?
